name: Test: SpriteBatch.Begin transform matrix (C#)
author: test
summary: Colored squares drawn through SpriteBatch.Begin with a scale, a translation, a rotation, Immediate, SpriteSortMode.Texture and the game's TransformationMatrix (which must not move anything).
description: Build with tools/tests/build-cs.sh csbatchmatrix. Logs 'csbatchmatrix screen <UI x,y of the physical top-left> <UI x,y of the physical bottom-right>', 'csbatchmatrix cell <name> x,y r,g,b', 'csbatchmatrix absent <name> x,y r,g,b' and 'csbatchmatrix END pass=N fail=M'; tools/tests/csbatchmatrix/screen.py checks a screenshot against them.
